label: Early input/delimiter step shortly after a y, 1, or s token
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase and on the <DEL> step (99% of mass; almost silent in the copy phase), mostly at steps 1-5, and mainly when one of the tokens y, 1, or s was input one or two steps earlier (prev_tok lift: y 7.1x, 1 5.9x, s 4.4x; h is weaker at 1.8x). Never fires at t=0. The largest activations (~1.0 of max) come from repeated y/1 runs early in the sequence (e.g. 1 y y <DEL>), peaking on the step after the run or on <DEL> for short sequences. The activation fades over a few steps after the trigger token. Weak, low-quartile activations also show up at early steps with no y/1/s nearby, so precision and recall are incomplete (dev F1 ~0.72, mass recall 0.85). It does not fire on copy-phase outputs, at step 0, or late in long sequences (t>=7), even when y/1/s came just before.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: y, 1, s, h, j, q; least: z, -, w, o) and the input two steps back (most: y, 1, s, h, q, t; least: f, u, w, o); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, t=4, L=3 & t=5.
